test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Rabble
solution:
The correct answer is '**Elite'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct meaning of the word 'Rabble' is jumbled, disordered group of people or items.
 
• The meaning of the word 'Elite' is the richest, most powerful, best-educated, or best-trained group in a society.
 
• Hence, the correct antonym for the word 'Rabble' is 'Elite'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__​​**

Let's look at the other word's meaning;

 
• Rubbish: something that you think is bad, silly or wrong. 
 
• Havoc: a situation in which there is a lot of damage or confusion.
 
• Noise: a sound, especially one that is loud or unpleasant.
